article.hook: You keep smoothing things over even when it costs you. The South Node hangs out here to make that stop feel unavoidable. It’s not about peace at any price - it’s about noticing what breaks when you always say yes.
article.lived: For nearly two years, you’ll see how easy it is to fall back into the habit of making yourself small for the sake of balance. Meetings drag on because nobody wants to ruffle feathers. Decisions get delayed so everyone feels included. You’ll watch groups hold the line on politeness while the real tension simmers underneath, unnoticed or ignored.
article.turn: The problem shows when you erase your own needs to keep things smooth - then wonder why you feel empty or resentful. Over-pleasing looks like kindness but acts like silence. You don’t have to sacrifice yourself to hold the peace; peace without you is just a quiet kind of loneliness.
moves: Say no to one request that doesn’t fit your actual limits this week.
Speak up about one decision where you’ve been staying quiet to avoid conflict.
Name one boundary you’ve ignored and enforce it clearly, even if it shakes things up.
